annotations.title: Stop Answering A Number From Your Own Twilio Account

description: Stop a voice agent answering a number from the business's own connected Twilio account and put back the call setting (VoiceUrl and VoiceMethod) the number had before it was attached. The number is never released from the account and its text settings are not touched. Requires admin role. Mirrors DELETE /api/v1/phone-numbers/external.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).
